[RARC.5.2.1] An engine's working memory holds every fact asserted into it.
Fact representation is the network's own: fact records over the schema.
Working memory is single-threaded. It is read and written only inside the
public call being processed, including from RHS action code running inside a
rule fire, which is still inside that call. The integrator must not make two
calls into one engine concurrently.
